purpose: Pinned upstream Android engine source restoration. This is not yet a working Windows Android build or a recovery of the missing custom implementation.

flattened_submodules.contents: All tracked blobs at the exact upstream gitlink commit; no nested Git metadata.

omitted_submodules.reason: Optional MariaDB/MySQL server integration is not part of this client restoration. No MongoDB client/database implementation is provided.

blockers: The upstream Android native scripts use linux-x86_64 NDK tools and require a Windows/MSYS2 port; native Python Windows selection also needs adaptation.
Android native dependency headers/libraries, SDK/NDK tools and an offline-complete Gradle dependency cache are not included.
SCons is not installed in the confirmed Windows environments; no SCons package is included here.
Upstream Gradle declarations are preserved, not yet adapted to the user's cached Gradle 8.9 and AGP 8.7.3 or installed NDK 30 beta.

Upstream CMake is retained as reference: it has no Android shared-library target and checks for Lua submodule .git metadata. Flattened Lua has no fake .git file; that CMake check still requires adaptation.

Bulk game data, translations and documentation/installer assets are omitted. Game/installer installation, translation generation and documentation targets are not supported by this source-only subset.
Upstream Android supports manual ZIP game-data import. No OBB loader has been implemented or verified.

omitted_content.reason: Large runtime assets are supplied separately as gamedata-1.19.26; this restoration does not package or transfer them.

paths: po/* except SConscript, CMakeLists.txt and LINGUAS
doc/* except selected build definitions and English manpages
omitted_content.reason: Retain build definitions while excluding bulk translation catalogues and manuals.
Desktop distribution tooling and asset bundles are outside this Android source checkpoint.
Custom Windows build scripts were empty and are not present in the pinned upstream tag. They are not reconstructed in this delivery.
Compiled libraries, dependency prefixes and download caches are intentionally not copied.

local_additions.purpose: Disable Git line-ending conversion in this pinned snapshot so raw source hashes and extensionless Bash scripts survive Windows checkout unchanged.
